hotspots.title: JD Vance Endorsement Drama
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance is locked in a public feud over his stance on a controversial attack ad and his expectations of a Trump endorsement for 2028, sparking sharp intra‑party criticism and media backlash.
hotspots.affect: The saga pits Vance against party hard‑liners and fuels accusations of whining, creating a heated moral‑panic narrative within the MAGA base.

hotspots.title: Rally Violence & Antisemitic Slur Fallout
hotspots.blurb: Multiple Trump rallies faced physical confrontations, threats against the former president, and condemnation after Trump used an antisemitic slur, prompting protests, arrests and widespread condemnation from Jewish groups.
hotspots.affect: The incidents combine street‑level aggression with hate‑speech accusations, amplifying alarm and moral outrage among both supporters and opponents.

hotspots.title: Farm Relief $8 B Program
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration rolled out an $8 billion one‑time payment package for farmers, touted as election‑season “goodies,” while farm groups demand more substantive trade solutions.
hotspots.affect: The promise of large cash payments frames the election as a direct economic lifeline, stoking both hope and criticism over pork‑barrel politics.

hotspots.title: Tariff Lawsuits on Canadian Goods
hotspots.blurb: Businesses and trade groups have filed lawsuits challenging the Trump administration’s 50% tariffs on Canadian imports, alleging overreach of executive authority.
hotspots.affect: The legal challenge is portrayed as a fight over sovereignty and economic harm, energizing protectionist narratives within the base.
